unsecured objects.

Fannett, Port Acres, and Southeast Texas Regional Airport.

events.summary:
At 150 PM MST, local law enforcement reported flooding on Lone Pine
Dam Road north of Lindon. Between 2 and 3.5 inches of rain have
fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.25 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Show Low, Taylor, Schoens Lake, Linden, Ned Lake, Fool Hollow Lake,
Telephone Lake, Pintail Lake, Pinedale, Clay Springs, White
Mountain Lakes Estates, White Mountain Lake Estates and White
Mountain Lake Airport.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 322 and 336. State Route 77
between mile markers 343 and 351.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Fool Hollow Lake Recreation Area Campground.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Dodson Wash, Pinedale Wash, Linden Draw, Show Low Creek, Hog Wash,
Cottonwood Wash, Rocky Arroyo, Stinson Wash and Silver Creek.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Berkeley, SC; Charleston, SC; Dorchester, SC
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Berkeley County in southeastern South Carolina...
Charleston County in southeastern South Carolina...
Dorchester County in southeastern South Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 615 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Overflowing poor drainage areas. Ponding of water in urban or other
areas is occurring or is imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 441 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated rainfall slowly
diminishing across the Charleston Metro area into lower
Charleston County as well as far southern Berkeley County. Minor
flooding of urban and low-lying areas is likely in progress and
even though the rain is diminishing, it will take some time for
flood waters to work through drainage systems.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
North Charleston, Goose Creek, Hanahan, I-26/I-526 Interchange,
West Ashley, Naval Weapons Station Charleston, Daniel Island and
Johns Island.
